subject.title: Multi-profile profile targeting/config truth is ambiguous with ~/.openclaw-* homes on macOS

question: Should explicit root `--profile` always override inherited OpenClaw-managed LaunchAgent labels, and should macOS profile names remain case-sensitive or be normalized for multi-profile homes?
rationale: The source-backed stale-label bug has a narrow repair shape, but preserving custom launchd labels and choosing case behavior are compatibility-sensitive product decisions for existing multi-profile operators.

options.title: Approve explicit-profile precedence
options.body: Treat previous-profile/default OpenClaw-managed labels as stale when a root profile is supplied, preserve intentional custom labels, and document the chosen casing behavior.

options.title: Require live macOS proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open without code changes until a real multi-profile macOS host demonstrates the exact status/restart failure and the proposed precedence rule.

options.title: Split the umbrella first
options.body: Track stale-label targeting, casing, mixed-layout docs, and config/load drift as separate scoped issues before implementation.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit-profile precedence
recommendation.body: Treat previous-profile/default OpenClaw-managed labels as stale when a root profile is supplied, preserve intentional custom labels, and document the chosen casing behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The key profile and gateway-service contracts trace back to steipete's feature-history commits, and the decision is about preserving or changing that contract.
